/lively.title: Ragavan Portfolio
/lively.description: As a User Experience designer, I have spent the past three years designing B2B SaaS products, building brands, and developing products. My background in commerce enhances my understanding of both products and their associated businesses.
h1: Crafting a mindfulness experience
Lively is a mindfulness app designed to transform traditional in-person mental wellness experiences into a seamless digital format.
Originating from a Malaysian-based parent organization, the idea was to make practices like meditation, sound healing, and wellness retreats accessible to users anytime, anywhere.
I took full ownership of Lively, leading the project from start to finish. I worked closely with stakeholders to align user needs with business goals.

This involved conducting workshops and discovery calls to understand the market, users, and business vision. I managed project workflows, UX research, wireframing, and UI design, ensuring a seamless and successful product launch.
Turning Mindfulness into a Digital Reality
With a streamlined approach, we bridged the gap between design and development effortlessly.
Clear communication is vital for managing stakeholders. Understanding diverse user needs beyond the scope was challenging but rewarding.
p: Lively evolved into an integrated digital platform delivering tangible mindfulness experiences via the internet. The application's intuitive interface, supplemented by directed meditations, auditory therapy, and virtual getaways, resulted in elevated user contentment and established Lively as the most financially rewarding project for our entity.
Research reports, user personas, journey maps, and stakeholder insights outlining key pain points and opportunities.

/consark-case.title: Ragavan Portfolio
/consark-case.description: As a User Experience designer, I have spent the past three years designing B2B SaaS products, building brands, and developing products. My background in commerce enhances my understanding of both products and their associated businesses.
h1: A Scalable User Centric Fintech SaaS Experience
Consark is a finance platform offering solutions for financial close, risk reporting, and compliance, serving clients in tech, ed-tech, and automotive sectors.

While being functional, the platform lacked a refined user experience. This redesign aimed to enhance usability, aesthetics, and scalability through structured UX research, prototyping, and a cohesive design system.

I led end-to-end UX and UI design, including discovery sessions, market research, stakeholder analysis, wireframing, and UI design. Additionally, I developed a scalable design system and collaborated closely with stakeholders and developers for a seamless handoff.
Only time my degree came to rescue me.With a commerce background, I deeply understood the product and empathized with accountants (Users) challenges.

Consark’s platform faces usability challenges, with workflows, navigation, and broken user journeys making everyday tasks cumbersome. This leads to frustration, reduced productivity, and lower engagement among clients.
As competition grows, improving the platform’s efficiency and user experience is critical to retaining customers and driving business growth.
Wedding between Excel and Jira
A Smarter, Sleeker Consark
With a well-structured delivery, we ensured a seamless transition from design to development.
We aced all hurdles
Collaboration is key, aligning stakeholders, developers, and users early on makes even the most complex projects smoother and more impactful.
p: Finance professionals rely on Excel for reports and audits, while Jira streamlines requests and workflows. Our approach fused these two worlds, crafting a seamless experience that balanced the flexibility of spreadsheets with the structure of workflow management—ensuring efficiency without disrupting familiar processes.

Through continuous collaboration with developers, stakeholders, and real users, we redefined Consark into a sleek, scalable, and intuitive platform. With improved navigation, enhanced workflows, and a polished experience, the product became more efficient and user-friendly. Despite multiple iterations, we delivered a refined solution within the set timeline, proving that great design is built through collaboration.
Research reports, user personas, journey maps, and stakeholder insights outlining key pain points and opportunities.
Optimized user flows, wireframes, and interaction models to enhance usability and efficiency.
High-fidelity UI designs, interactive prototypes, and developer-ready assets ensuring clarity in implementation.
A scalable design system with reusable components, typography, colors, and design guidelines for consistency across the platform.
Navigating a complex product with multiple modules took time to map existing flows and connect journeys.
Coordinating discovery sessions with numerous stakeholders and aligning diverse perspectives.
Co-creating with developers and stakeholders was challenging but led to a stronger outcome.
Documenting design decisions was time-intensive but ensured clarity and consistency.
